scope: Prior-informed independent method/code inspection, not source acquisition, new image scoring, listening, human acceptance or engineering opinion.
decision: Exactly two matched first-static-fit arms are justified. The fixed factor corrects a known relative distortion introduced by the declared digital-raster normalization, without asserting the original camera geometry. No method defect requiring protocol revision was found.

derivation.mapping_limit: These are geometric pixel-center maps. Two-stage bilinear filtering and intermediate integer pixels are not equivalent to a single continuous-point intensity sample.

geometry_only_oracles.quantization_limit: Actual rounded magnifications, centered origins and clipping must be retained; requested scale alone is not the native map.

resolved_design_risks: Both new arms fit only the first inherited static rectangle. Old combined-static results remain history, not a like-for-like control.
The same core.working then canvas-resize pipeline is retained in both arms. Direct native resizing or letterboxing is not silently introduced.
Static evaluation and dynamic regions are withheld from transform estimation, not genuinely unseen data; previous score and scene familiarity is disclosed.

Different valid pixels can change correlation even at identical coverage counts. The protocol retains set equality and common-valid-pixel diagnostics with the full-mask denominator and unchanged gates; no refit or ranking from that diagnostic.
Top-two fits, all rankings, near-best sets, nulls and boundary leaders remain visible. Source ordering is descriptive, not a clock or unique correspondence.
strongest_objection: Native access-raster aspect is not necessarily true scene aspect. Existing transfers can already contain anisotropic scaling, cropping, pixel-aspect changes, perspective or parallax. One tall repetitive facade can fit spuriously, and the other facade may occupy a different depth or be occluded. Broad evolving cloud can correlate at nearby times or cameras. Corrected-arm gains therefore demonstrate sensitivity to this declared processing choice, not that the correction reconstructs true geometry or proves shared exposure.
pre_historical_checks_required_not_yet_r: Pinned source/config/method/runtimes and all 41 selected PNGs/PTS before and after.
Fresh inherited core/adapter controls and new factor-one equivalence, exact size/origin/mask/mapping, padding/clipping and null/tie controls.
Known aspect and changed-evaluation synthetic counterexamples, including unchanged fitting scores with conflicting evaluation detail.
Independent selected-fit/evaluation/common-support direct arithmetic within score1e-9 and coverage1e-12, complete saved-surface top-two selection and all228 arm-pair memberships.
Two-run product identity, input omission/stale-control rejection and exclusive-write refusal.
finite_stop: Exactly C14/C19/C24 times all38 early samples in both fixed arms; two runs capped at600 seconds and384 MiB each, followed by independent arithmetic and at most36 unique shortlisted early images plus three C references. Stop for positive, mixed, null or failed results. No automatic finer-time search, additional aspect/warp family, audio alignment or time-map fitting.
claim_ceiling: A reproduced, prior-informed processing-sensitivity result and qualified picture-correspondence lead or limitation. No sound authenticity, original-capture speed, continuous-source authentication, historical clock, physical mechanism or cause ranking.
actions_performed: Read-only cat/sed/rg inspections and SHA256 checks; elementary dimension/mask-center calculations only. No new historical score, source decoding, source annotation, acquisition or external action.
